# ParticleOverrides

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct ParticleOverrides
```

Changes to an effect's values for one burst, such as a direction or color that depends on where it's used. Values left null keep the effect's.
